# Set Up

## Load Libraries

```{r library}
suppressMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(readr)
  library(SummarizedExperiment)
})

base_dir <- rprojroot::find_root(
  rprojroot::has_dir("AD_CR_HRS"),
  path = here::here()
)
analysis_dir <- file.path(base_dir, "AD_CR_HRS")
data_dir <- file.path(analysis_dir, "data")
hrs_dir <- file.path(base_dir, "DATASET", "_HARMONIZATION", "data")
reference_dir <- file.path(analysis_dir, "data", "ref_files")
save_dir <- file.path(analysis_dir, "analysis-results")
code_dir <- file.path(analysis_dir, "code", "R")

source(file.path(code_dir, "mrs_weights.R"))
source(file.path(code_dir, "mrs_scoring.R"))
```

# Load Data

```{r load}
# read DNAm data
dnam_data <- readRDS(
  file.path(hrs_dir, "batch_corrected", "HRS_White_NHispanic_PCA.RDS")
)

# Filter to samples we used for analysis
merge_df <- read.csv(file.path(data_dir, "NHW_HCAP_MCI.csv"))
dnam_data <- dnam_data[
  , dnam_data$SubjectID_Submitter %in% merge_df$SubjectID_Submitter
]

# get beta values
beta_data <- SummarizedExperiment::assays(dnam_data)$dnam
beta_data <- beta_data[
  , match(merge_df$SubjectID_Submitter, dnam_data$SubjectID_Submitter)
]
colnames(beta_data) <- merge_df$SubjectID_Submitter
```

# Analyze

```{r run, fig.width = 8, fig.height = 6}
run_mrs_analysis(
  beta_data,
  out_dir = file.path(save_dir, "mrs"),
  nonfinite_message = "MRS is non-finite for one or more samples."
)
```

# Save to Phenotype

```{r save}
mrs_df <- read.csv(file.path(save_dir, "mrs", "EAP_MRS_scores.csv"))
pheno_df <- merge_df %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    mrs_df,
    by = c("SubjectID_Submitter" = "sample_id"),
    relationship = "one-to-one",
    na_matches = "never"
  )

write.csv(
  pheno_df,
  file = file.path(save_dir, "mrs", "pheno_data.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)
```
